input_authority.compact_index: GitHub Actions run 514 deterministic memory-compact-indexes artifact

review_lenses.assessment: The compact layer spans the pre-2019 investment setup through the 2019-2020 downcycle and later cycle revisions. The lack of a dedicated 2015 event is not judged a material first-order gap because the conversion-capex and hydroxide-expectation setup is explicitly represented from 2016-2018.

The compact index contains 82 distinct actor names or role labels, including Tianqi/Kwinana, Albemarle/Kemerton, Ganfeng, Yahua, regional converters, new entrants, toll processors, price agencies, local regulators and feedstock/customer roles. The shard is not limited to current winners.

Mechanical completion, first product, customer qualification, stable battery-grade output, low utilization, shutdown/care-and-maintenance, restart and multi-train ramp are represented as distinct or reversible states. Nameplate is not treated as effective supply.

Industrial-grade versus battery-grade carbonate, hydroxide, route-specific recovery/material intensity, WIP/mother-liquor/rework and deliverable-versus-accounting output are represented. A tonne of nominal lithium salt is not assumed semantically interchangeable.

Spot/contract/export/futures bases, grade differences, raw-material contract reset timing, product contract repricing timing, tolling versus self-owned feedstock and merchant-versus-captive ownership are represented.

Conversion route, purification/recrystallization, impurity control, batch consistency, product switching limits, customer qualification, yield/recovery and lithium-mica waste constraints are represented.

The shard preserves 2017-2018 hydroxide-premium/high-nickel expectations, management ramp-guidance revision mechanics, 2019-2021 hydroxide-demand expectations and later revisions rather than rewriting these as final truth.

Historical search vocabulary includes lithium-salt processing, base lithium salts, causticization, purification, toll processing, mica-to-lithium, ore-to-lithium and brine-to-lithium terms, plus project/company aliases.

Five explicit failure/dead-end leads plus reversible project-state leads cover delayed ramp, qualification failure, capital pressure, under-utilized local projects and announced capacity that never became effective supply.

The shard explicitly bridges mine/concentrate availability to battery-grade chemical supply through feedstock ownership, conversion yield, qualification, inventory/WIP, product specification and pricing. Remaining questions are primarily claim verification rather than missing blind-memory categories.

verdict.reason: Three consecutive independent low-novelty probes produced no new category, the all-lens negative-space review found no material first-order empty cell for the first replay, and all required long-tail categories are represented.
verdict.important_limit: Seal freezes the blind-memory atlas for this shard; it does not make any Memory Lead true, publishable or evidence-backed.
